label: Neolithic / Chalcolithic
description: Stone weapons, simple bow; no armor; rafts and canoes; palisades; porters; runners.

label: Early Bronze Age
description: Copper/bronze maces and spears; leather armor, copper helmets; oared riverboats; mudbrick walls; donkeys and carts; runners and signal fires.

label: Late Bronze Age
description: Composite bow, war chariot, bronze swords; bronze scale armor; oared war galleys; stone citadels; ox wagons and depots; couriers.

label: Classical Iron Age
description: Iron weapons, torsion artillery, sarissa; bronze/iron cuirass, mail; triremes and quinqueremes; ashlar city walls, siege towers; engineered roads, depot system; mounted relay posts.

label: High Middle Ages
description: Crossbow, longbow, couched lance, trebuchet; plate-and-mail, barding; cogs and galleys; concentric castles; river transport, granaries; relay horses (yam).

label: Early gunpowder (pike and shot)
description: Arquebus/musket, pike, field cannon; half-armor, cuirass; galleons, early ships of the line; trace italienne; magazines, canal transport; couriers, early postal systems.

label: Napoleonic
description: Flintlock musket, 12-pdr gun, Gribeauval system; no armor or cuirass only; 74-gun ships of the line; Vauban-type forts; magazines plus requisition; semaphore telegraph.

label: Industrial (pre-WWI)
description: Magazine rifle, machine gun, QF artillery; armored cars, steel helmet (1915); dreadnoughts, steam; concrete forts, trenches; railways; electric telegraph, telephone. ISR 7 = aerial reconnaissance (1914), air 7 = 1914 aircraft.

label: Second World War
description: Tanks, dive bombers, radar-directed AA; rolled homogeneous armor; carriers, radar, submarines; concrete lines; motor transport and rail; radio at company level. ISR 8 = radar.

label: Late Cold War
description: Guided missiles, MBTs with fire control, jets; composite armor; nuclear submarines, Aegis; hardened shelters; containerised logistics, airlift; satellite comms and data links. ISR 9 = satellites, cyber 9 = 1990 networks.

label: 2026 frontier
description: Precision munitions, drones, hypersonics; active protection; networked fleets, USVs; layered air defence; just-in-time, global sealift; networked C4ISR. ISR 10 = persistent drone/space ISR, air 10 = 5th generation, cyber 10 = state cyber forces.
